-- Safe project-relative filesystem operations for HyperMax.
local Filesystem = {}
local uv = vim.uv or vim.loop

local function Normalize(path)
	if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" then return nil end
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		if vim.fs and vim.fs.normalize then return vim.fs.normalize(path) end
		return vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":p")
	end)
	if not ok or type(result) ~= "string" then return nil end
	if result:sub(1, 1) ~= "/" then
		local absolute_ok, absolute = pcall(vim.fn.fnamemodify, result, ":p")
		if not absolute_ok or type(absolute) ~= "string" then return nil end
		result = absolute
	end
	if result ~= "/" then result = result:gsub("/+$", "") end
	return result
end

local function Is_Within(root, path)
	root, path = Normalize(root), Normalize(path)
	if not root or not path or path == root then return false end
	if root == "/" then return path:sub(1, 1) == "/" end
	return path:sub(1, #root + 1) == root .. "/"
end

local function Realpath(path)
	if uv.fs_realpath then
		local ok, result = pcall(uv.fs_realpath, path)
		if ok and result then return Normalize(result) end
	end
	return Normalize(path)
end

local function Has_Unsafe_Ancestor(root_path, root_real, path)
	local cursor = Normalize(vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":h"))
	while cursor do
		local stat = uv.fs_lstat(cursor)
		if stat then
			local real = Realpath(cursor)
			if real and real ~= root_real and not Is_Within(root_real, real) then
				return true, "Path crosses a symbolic link outside the project"
			end
			if cursor == root_path then break end
		end
		if cursor == root_path then break end
		local parent = Normalize(vim.fn.fnamemodify(cursor, ":h"))
		if not parent or parent == cursor then break end
		cursor = parent
	end
	return false
end

function Filesystem.Normalize(path)
	return Normalize(path)
end

function Filesystem.Is_Within(root, path)
	return Is_Within(root, path)
end

function Filesystem.Safe_Child(root, input)
	if type(root) ~= "string" or root == "" then return nil, "Project root is not set" end
	if type(input) ~= "string" then return nil, "Path must be text" end
	input = vim.trim(input):gsub("\\", "/")
	if input == "" then return nil, "Enter a non-empty relative path" end
	if input:find("%z") or input:find("[%c]") then return nil, "Path contains an invalid control character" end
	if input:sub(1, 1) == "/" or input:match("^%a:") or input:sub(1, 1) == "~" then
		return nil, "Enter a relative path inside the project"
	end
	for part in input:gmatch("[^/]+") do
		if part == "." or part == ".." then
			return nil, "Relative paths cannot contain . or .."
		end
	end
	local root_path = Normalize(root)
	if not root_path then return nil, "Project root is not a valid path" end
	local full_path = Normalize(root_path .. "/" .. input)
	if not full_path or not Is_Within(root_path, full_path) then
		return nil, "Path must stay inside the project"
	end
	local root_real = Realpath(root_path)
	local real_root = root_real or root_path
	local unsafe, reason = Has_Unsafe_Ancestor(root_path, real_root, full_path)
	if unsafe then return nil, reason end
	local existing = uv.fs_lstat(full_path)
	if existing and existing.type == "link" then
		local target = Realpath(full_path)
		if target and target ~= real_root and not Is_Within(real_root, target) then
			return nil, "Target symbolic link points outside the project"
		end
	end
	return full_path
end

local function Ensure_Directory(path)
	local stat = uv.fs_stat(path)
	if stat then
		if stat.type == "directory" then return true end
		return false, "A non-directory already exists in the path: " .. path
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(vim.fn.mkdir, path, "p")
	if not ok then return false, tostring(err) end
	stat = uv.fs_stat(path)
	if not stat or stat.type ~= "directory" then
		return false, "Could not create directory: " .. path
	end
	return true
end

function Filesystem.Create(root, kind, input)
	if input == nil or (type(input) == "string" and vim.trim(input) == "") then
		return false, nil, "cancelled"
	end
	if kind ~= "file" and kind ~= "folder" then
		return false, nil, "Unknown item type: " .. tostring(kind)
	end
	local path, path_error = Filesystem.Safe_Child(root, input)
	if not path then return false, nil, path_error end
	if uv.fs_lstat(path) then return false, nil, "Already exists: " .. tostring(input) end

	local root_path = Normalize(root)
	local parent = Normalize(vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":h"))
	if parent ~= root_path then
		local parent_ok, parent_error = Ensure_Directory(parent)
		if not parent_ok then return false, nil, parent_error end
	end

	if kind == "folder" then
		local ok, err = pcall(vim.fn.mkdir, path, "p")
		if not ok then return false, nil, "Could not create folder: " .. tostring(err) end
		local stat = uv.fs_stat(path)
		if not stat or stat.type ~= "directory" then
			return false, nil, "Could not create folder: " .. tostring(input)
		end
	else
		local fd, open_error = uv.fs_open(path, "wx", 420)
		if not fd then return false, nil, "Could not create file: " .. tostring(open_error) end
		local close_ok, close_error = uv.fs_close(fd)
		if close_ok == nil or close_ok == false then
			pcall(uv.fs_unlink, path)
			return false, nil, "Could not close new file: " .. tostring(close_error)
		end
	end
	return true, path
end


local function Is_Protected_Relative(relative)
	for part in relative:gsub("\\", "/"):gmatch("[^/]+") do
		if part == ".hmc" or part == ".git" then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function Relative_Path(root, full)
	local normalized_root, normalized_full = Normalize(root), Normalize(full)
	if not normalized_root or not normalized_full or not Is_Within(normalized_root, normalized_full) then return nil end
	return normalized_full:sub(#normalized_root + 2)
end

function Filesystem.Move(root, source_input, destination_input)
	if type(root) ~= "string" or root == "" then return false, nil, "Project root is not set" end
	if type(source_input) ~= "string" or vim.trim(source_input) == "" then return false, nil, "Source path is required" end
	if type(destination_input) ~= "string" or vim.trim(destination_input) == "" then return false, nil, "Destination path is required" end
	local source, source_error = Filesystem.Safe_Child(root, source_input)
	if not source then return false, nil, source_error end
	local destination, destination_error = Filesystem.Safe_Child(root, destination_input)
	if not destination then return false, nil, destination_error end
	local source_relative = Relative_Path(root, source)
	local destination_relative = Relative_Path(root, destination)
	if not source_relative or not destination_relative then return false, nil, "Paths must remain inside the project" end
	if Is_Protected_Relative(source_relative) or Is_Protected_Relative(destination_relative) then
		return false, nil, "Git and HyperMax metadata paths cannot be moved from the dashboard"
	end
	local source_stat = uv.fs_lstat(source)
	if not source_stat then return false, nil, "Source does not exist: " .. source_input end
	if source == destination then return false, nil, "Source and destination are the same path" end
	if uv.fs_lstat(destination) then return false, nil, "Destination already exists: " .. destination_input end
	if source_stat.type == "directory" and Is_Within(source, destination) then
		return false, nil, "A folder cannot be moved into itself or one of its descendants"
	end
	local parent = Normalize(vim.fn.fnamemodify(destination, ":h"))
	local parent_stat = parent and uv.fs_stat(parent)
	if not parent_stat or parent_stat.type ~= "directory" then
		return false, nil, "Destination folder does not exist: " .. tostring(parent)
	end
	local ok, err = uv.fs_rename(source, destination)
	if not ok then return false, nil, "Move failed: " .. tostring(err) end
	return true, destination
end

function Filesystem.Delete(root, input)
	if type(root) ~= "string" or root == "" then return false, "Project root is not set" end
	if type(input) ~= "string" or vim.trim(input) == "" then return false, "Path is required" end
	local path, path_error = Filesystem.Safe_Child(root, input)
	if not path then return false, path_error end
	local relative = Relative_Path(root, path)
	if not relative then return false, "Path must be inside the project" end
	if Is_Protected_Relative(relative) then return false, "Git and HyperMax metadata cannot be deleted from the dashboard" end
	if not uv.fs_lstat(path) then return false, "Path does not exist: " .. input end
	local ok, result = pcall(vim.fn.delete, path, "rf")
	if not ok or result ~= 0 then return false, "Delete failed: " .. tostring(result) end
	return true
end

function Filesystem.Exists(root, input)
	local path = Filesystem.Safe_Child(root, input)
	return path ~= nil and uv.fs_lstat(path) ~= nil
end

return Filesystem

-- Small, testable Git wrapper used by the HyperMax dashboard.
local Git = {}
local uv = vim.uv or vim.loop

local function Normalize(path)
	if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" then return nil end
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		if vim.fs and vim.fs.normalize then return vim.fs.normalize(path) end
		return vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":p")
	end)
	if not ok or type(result) ~= "string" or result == "" then return nil end
	if result:sub(1, 1) ~= "/" then
		local absolute_ok, absolute = pcall(vim.fn.fnamemodify, result, ":p")
		if not absolute_ok or type(absolute) ~= "string" then return nil end
		result = absolute
	end
	if result ~= "/" then result = result:gsub("/+$", "") end
	return result
end

function Git.Run(root, args)
	if type(root) ~= "string" or root == "" then return nil, "Project root is not set" end
	if type(args) ~= "table" or #args == 0 then return nil, "Git arguments must be a non-empty list" end
	if vim.fn.executable("git") ~= 1 then return nil, "Git is not installed or not on PATH" end
	local normalized_root = Normalize(root)
	if not normalized_root then return nil, "Project root is not a valid path" end
	local command = { "git", "-C", normalized_root }
	for _, arg in ipairs(args) do
		if type(arg) ~= "string" then return nil, "Git arguments must all be strings" end
		command[#command + 1] = arg
	end
	local ok, output = pcall(vim.fn.systemlist, command)
	if not ok then return nil, tostring(output) end
	local exit_code = vim.v.shell_error
	if exit_code ~= 0 then return nil, table.concat(output or {}, "\n"), exit_code end
	return output or {}, nil, 0
end

function Git.Repository_Root(root)
	local output = Git.Run(root, { "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel" })
	if not output or not output[1] or output[1] == "" then return nil end
	return Normalize(output[1])
end

function Git.Is_Repository(root)
	return Git.Repository_Root(root) ~= nil
end

function Git.Branch(root)
	local output = Git.Run(root, { "branch", "--show-current" })
	if not output then return nil end
	if output[1] and output[1] ~= "" then return output[1] end
	local commit = Git.Run(root, { "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD" })
	if commit and commit[1] and commit[1] ~= "" then return "detached@" .. commit[1] end
	return "unborn"
end

local function Unquote_Path(path)
	if path:sub(1, 1) ~= '"' or path:sub(-1) ~= '"' then return path end
	path = path:sub(2, -2)
	path = path:gsub("\\(%d%d%d)", function(octal)
		return string.char(tonumber(octal, 8))
	end)
	path = path:gsub('\\([\\"tnr])', function(char)
		local replacements = { ["\\"] = "\\", ['"'] = '"', t = "\t", n = "\n", r = "\r" }
		return replacements[char] or char
	end)
	return path
end

function Git.Parse_Status(lines, root)
	local statuses = {}
	root = Normalize(root)
	if not root then return statuses end
	for _, row in ipairs(lines or {}) do
		if type(row) == "string" and #row >= 3 then
			local code, path = row:sub(1, 2), row:sub(4)
			local valid_code = code ~= "##" and code:match("^[ MADRCTU?!][ MADRCTU?!]$") ~= nil
			if valid_code and path ~= "" then
				if (code:find("R", 1, true) or code:find("C", 1, true)) and path:find(" -> ", 1, true) then
					path = path:match(" -> (.+)$") or path
				end
				path = Unquote_Path(path)
				local full = Normalize(root .. "/" .. path)
				if full ~= root and full:sub(1, #root + 1) == root .. "/" then
					statuses[full] = code
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return statuses
end

function Git.Status(root)
	local output, err = Git.Run(root, { "-c", "core.quotepath=false", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all" })
	if not output then return nil, err end
	local repository_root = Git.Repository_Root(root) or Normalize(root)
	return Git.Parse_Status(output, repository_root), nil, output
end

function Git.Snapshot(root)
	local snapshot = { available = false, branch = nil, statuses = {}, repository_root = nil }
	local repository_root = Git.Repository_Root(root)
	if not repository_root then return snapshot end
	snapshot.available = true
	snapshot.repository_root = repository_root
	snapshot.branch = Git.Branch(root) or "unborn"
	snapshot.statuses = Git.Status(root) or {}
	return snapshot
end

function Git.Init(root)
	return Git.Run(root, { "init" })
end

function Git.Add_All(root)
	return Git.Run(root, { "add", "-A" })
end

function Git.Commit(root, message)
	if type(message) ~= "string" or vim.trim(message) == "" then return nil, "Commit message cannot be empty" end
	return Git.Run(root, { "commit", "-m", message })
end

function Git.Recent(root, count)
	count = tonumber(count) or 5
	if count ~= count or count == math.huge or count == -math.huge then count = 5 end
	count = math.max(1, math.min(100, math.floor(count)))
	return Git.Run(root, { "--no-pager", "log", "-" .. tostring(count), "--oneline", "--decorate" })
end

return Git

local function Run_Health_Check()
	-- Find the plugin root from this file's location.
	local source = debug.getinfo(1, "S").source

	if source:sub(1, 1) == "@" then
		source = source:sub(2)
	end

	local plugin_root = vim.fs.dirname(vim.fs.dirname(vim.fs.dirname(source)))

	local test_file = plugin_root .. "/tests/run.lua"

	if vim.fn.filereadable(test_file) ~= 1 then
		vim.notify("HyperMax: Could not find tests/run.lua\n" .. test_file, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return
	end

	vim.notify("HyperMax: Running health checks...", vim.log.levels.INFO)

	-- Run tests in a clean Neovim process.
	vim.system({
		vim.v.progpath,
		"--headless",
		"-u",
		"NONE",
		"-c",
		"set rtp^=.",
		"-c",
		"luafile tests/run.lua",
		"-c",
		"qa!",
	}, {
		cwd = plugin_root,
		text = true,
	}, function(result)
		vim.schedule(function()
			local output = {
				"HyperMax Health Check",
				"=====================",
				"",
				"Exit code: " .. tostring(result.code),
				"",
			}

			vim.list_extend(
				output,
				vim.split(result.stdout or "", "\n", {
					plain = true,
					trimempty = true,
				})
			)

			if result.stderr and result.stderr ~= "" then
				vim.list_extend(output, { "", "Errors:" })
				-- nvim_buf_set_lines accepts one line per array item. Never insert
				-- the complete stderr string as one item: it may contain newlines.
				vim.list_extend(output, vim.split(result.stderr, "\n", { plain = true, trimempty = true }))
			end

			-- Display results in a scratch buffer.
			vim.cmd("botright new")

			local buffer = vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf()

			vim.bo[buffer].buftype = "nofile"
			vim.bo[buffer].bufhidden = "wipe"
			vim.bo[buffer].swapfile = false
			vim.bo[buffer].filetype = "text"

			vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(buffer, 0, -1, false, output)

			vim.bo[buffer].modifiable = false

			if result.code == 0 then
				vim.notify("HyperMax: Health checks passed", vim.log.levels.INFO)
			else
				vim.notify(
					"HyperMax: Health checks failed (exit code " .. tostring(result.code) .. ")",
					vim.log.levels.ERROR
				)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

local function Convert_Folder(path)
	local Dashboard = require("hypermax.dashboard")
	local ok, result = Dashboard.Convert_Folder(path)
	if not ok then return false, result end
	return true, "Converted folder to HyperMax project: " .. path
end

local function Undo_Conversion(path)
	local Dashboard = require("hypermax.dashboard")
	local ok, result = Dashboard.Undo_Conversion(path)
	if not ok then return false, result end
	return true, "Conversion undone. Metadata backup: " .. tostring(result)
end

local function Scrape_Project(path)
	local Dashboard = require("hypermax.dashboard")
	local ok, result = Dashboard.Scrape(path)
	if not ok then return false, result end
	return true, "Project metadata removed. Backup: " .. tostring(result)
end

	pcall(vim.api.nvim_del_user_command, "HyperMaxHealthCheck")

	vim.api.nvim_create_user_command("HyperMaxHealthCheck", Run_Health_Check, {
		desc = "Run HyperMax health checks",
	})
	for _, command in ipairs({ "HyperMaxConvert", "HyperMaxUndoConversion", "HyperMaxScrape" }) do
		pcall(vim.api.nvim_del_user_command, command)
	end
	vim.api.nvim_create_user_command("HyperMaxConvert", function(opts)
		local path = Current_Path(opts.args)
		local ok, result = Convert_Folder(path)
		vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. tostring(result), ok and vim.log.levels.INFO or vim.log.levels.ERROR)
	end, { nargs = "?", complete = "dir", desc = "Convert an existing folder into a HyperMax project" })

		local path = Current_Path(opts.args)
		Confirm_Action("Undo folder conversion? Existing files will remain; .hmc will be backed up", function() return Undo_Conversion(path) end)
	end, { nargs = "?", complete = "dir", desc = "Undo a HyperMax folder conversion" })
	vim.api.nvim_create_user_command("HyperMaxScrape", function(opts)
		local path = Current_Path(opts.args)
		Confirm_Action("Remove HyperMax metadata from this project? A backup will be kept", function() return Scrape_Project(path) end)
	end, { nargs = "?", complete = "dir", desc = "Remove HyperMax metadata from a project" })

	-- =====================================================

	-- =====================================================

	Map("+", function()
		vim.ui.select({
			"Projects",
			"Settings",
			"Load layout",
			"Save current project as layout",
			"Open last project",
			"List layouts",
			"Health Check",
			"Convert current folder into project",
			"Undo folder conversion",
			"Remove project metadata (scrape)",
		}, {
			prompt = "HyperMax",
		}, function(choice)
			if not choice then
				return
			end

			if choice == "Projects" then
				Project.List()
			elseif choice == "Settings" then
				Settings.Open()
			elseif choice == "Load layout" then
				Project.Load_Layout()
			elseif choice == "Save current project as layout" then
				Project.Save_Layout()
			elseif choice == "Open last project" then
				Project.Open_Last()
			elseif choice == "List layouts" then
				local ids = Layouts.Get_IDs()
				local choices = {}

				for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
					local layout = Layouts.Get(id)

					if layout then
						choices[#choices + 1] = layout
					end
				end

				if #choices == 0 then
					vim.notify("HyperMax: No layouts are available", vim.log.levels.WARN)
					return
				end

				vim.ui.select(choices, {
					prompt = "Choose layout",
					format_item = function(layout)
						local name = layout.name or layout.id

						if layout.description and layout.description ~= "" then
							return name .. " — " .. layout.description
						end

						return name
					end,
				}, function(layout)
					if not layout then
						return
					end

					Project.Create(
						vim.tbl_deep_extend(
							"force",
							{},
							require("hypermax.config").options or {},
							{ default_layout = layout.id }
						)
					)
				end)
			elseif choice == "Health Check" then
				Run_Health_Check()

				local ok, result = Convert_Folder(path)
				vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. tostring(result), ok and vim.log.levels.INFO or vim.log.levels.ERROR)

				Confirm_Action("Undo folder conversion? Existing files will remain; .hmc will be backed up", function() return Undo_Conversion(path) end)
			elseif choice == "Remove project metadata (scrape)" then
				local path = Current_Path(nil)
				Confirm_Action("Remove HyperMax metadata? A backup will be kept", function() return Scrape_Project(path) end)
			end
		end)
	end, "Open menu")

	-- =====================================================
	-- PROJECTS
	-- =====================================================

	Map("p", function()

	end, "List projects")

	Map("n", function()
		Project.Create(require("hypermax.config").options)
	end, "New project")

	Map("r", function()
		vim.cmd("HyperMaxCreate")
	end, "Create project using wizard")

	Map("o", function()
		Project.Open_Last()
	end, "Open last project")

	Map("q", function()
		Project.Quick_Create()
	end, "Quick project creation")

	-- =====================================================
	-- SETTINGS AND LAYOUTS
	-- =====================================================

	Map("s", function()
		Settings.Open()
	end, "Settings")

	Map("l", function()
		Project.Load_Layout()
	end, "Load layout")

	Map("L", function()
		Project.Save_Layout()
	end, "Save current project as layout")

	Map("c", function()
		vim.cmd("HyperMaxConfig")
	end, "Show configuration")

	-- =====================================================
	-- HEALTH CHECK
	-- =====================================================

	Map("h", function()
		Run_Health_Check()
	end, "Health check")

	Map("C", function()
		local path = Current_Path(nil)
		local ok, result = Convert_Folder(path)
		vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. tostring(result), ok and vim.log.levels.INFO or vim.log.levels.ERROR)

-- =========================================================
-- PUBLIC FUNCTIONS
-- =========================================================

-- Return every registered language.
function Languages.Get_All()
	return Languages.registry
end

-- Return a language by its registry ID.
function Languages.Get(id)
	return Languages.registry[id]
end

-- Return whether a language is registered.
function Languages.Exists(id)
	return Languages.registry[id] ~= nil
end

-- Return the number of registered languages.
function Languages.Count()
	local count = 0

	for _ in pairs(Languages.registry) do
		count = count + 1
	end

	return count
end

-- Check whether the language's configured executable exists.
--
-- true  = executable exists
-- false = executable is missing
-- nil   = language is unknown or has no configured executable
function Languages.Is_Installed(id)
	local language = Languages.registry[id]

	if not language or not language.executable then
		return nil
	end

	return vim.fn.executable(language.executable) == 1
end

-- Return the configured executable for a language.
function Languages.Get_Executable(id)
	local language = Languages.registry[id]

	if not language then
		return nil
	end

	return language.executable
end

-- Return the default source filename for a language.
function Languages.Get_Default_File(id)
	local language = Languages.registry[id]

	if not language then
		return nil
	end

	return language.file
end

-- Return all registered language IDs in alphabetical order.
function Languages.Get_IDs()
	local ids = {}

	for id in pairs(Languages.registry) do
		ids[#ids + 1] = id
	end

	table.sort(ids)

	return ids
end

return Languages

local Layouts = {}

local uv = vim.uv or vim.loop

local function Get_Module_Directory()
	local source = debug.getinfo(1, "S").source

	if source:sub(1, 1) ~= "@" then
		return vim.fn.getcwd()
	end

	return vim.fn.fnamemodify(source:sub(2), ":p:h")
end

Layouts.json_path = Get_Module_Directory() .. "/layouts.json"
Layouts.user_path = vim.fn.stdpath("data") .. "/hypermax/layouts.json"

-- =========================================================
-- FILESYSTEM
-- =========================================================

local function Is_Directory(path)
	local stat = uv.fs_stat(path)
	return stat ~= nil and stat.type == "directory"
end

local function Read_File(path)
	local file = io.open(path, "r")

	if not file then
		return nil
	end

	local content = file:read("*a")
	file:close()

	return content
end

local function Read_JSON(path)
	local content = Read_File(path)

	if not content then
		return nil, "Could not read JSON file: " .. path
	end

	local ok, decoded = pcall(vim.json.decode, content)

	if not ok or type(decoded) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "Invalid JSON in " .. path
	end

	return decoded
end

local function Write_JSON(path, data)
	local parent = vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":h")
	local mkdir_ok = vim.fn.mkdir(parent, "p")

	if mkdir_ok == 0 and not Is_Directory(parent) then
		return false, "Could not create directory: " .. parent
	end

	local ok, encoded = pcall(vim.json.encode, data)

	if not ok then
		return false, "Could not encode JSON: " .. tostring(encoded)
	end

	local file, err = io.open(path, "w")

	if not file then
		return false, err
	end

	local write_ok, write_err = file:write(vim.json.format and vim.json.format(encoded) or encoded, "\n")

	local close_ok, close_err = file:close()

	if not write_ok then
		return false, write_err
	end

	if close_ok == nil then
		return false, close_err
	end

	return true
end

local function Deep_Copy(value)
	return vim.deepcopy(value)
end

local function Merge(destination, source)
	return vim.tbl_deep_extend("force", destination or {}, source or {})
end

-- =========================================================
-- PATH VALIDATION
-- =========================================================

function Layouts.Is_Safe_Path(path)
	if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" then
		return false
	end

	if path:find("%z") or path:find("\\") then
		return false
	end

	if path:sub(1, 1) == "/" or path:match("^%a:") then
		return false
	end

	for part in path:gmatch("[^/]+") do
		if part == "." or part == ".." then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

local function Validate_Files(files, label)
	if type(files) ~= "table" then
		return false, label .. ".files must be a table"
	end

	for path, content in pairs(files) do
		if not Layouts.Is_Safe_Path(path) then
			return false, "Unsafe file path: " .. tostring(path)
		end

		if type(content) ~= "string" then
			return false, "File contents must be strings: " .. path
		end
	end

	return true
end

local function Validate_Directories(directories, label)
	if type(directories) ~= "table" then
		return false, label .. ".directories must be a list"
	end

	for _, path in ipairs(directories) do
		if not Layouts.Is_Safe_Path(path) then
			return false, "Unsafe directory path: " .. tostring(path)
		end
	end

	return true
end

local function Validate_Layout(id, layout)
	if type(layout) ~= "table" then
		return false, "Layout must be a table: " .. tostring(id)
	end

	if layout.name ~= nil and type(layout.name) ~= "string" then
		return false, "Layout name must be a string: " .. id
	end

	if layout.description ~= nil and type(layout.description) ~= "string" then
		return false, "Layout description must be a string: " .. id
	end

	if layout.languages ~= nil then
		if type(layout.languages) ~= "table" then
			return false, "Layout languages must be a list: " .. id
		end

		for _, language_id in ipairs(layout.languages) do
			if type(language_id) ~= "string" then
				return false, "Invalid language ID in layout: " .. id
			end
		end
	end

	if layout.entry ~= nil then
		if not Layouts.Is_Safe_Path(layout.entry) then
			return false, "Unsafe layout entry path: " .. id
		end
	end

	if layout.directories ~= nil then
		local ok, err = Validate_Directories(layout.directories, id)

		if not ok then
			return false, err
		end
	end

	if layout.files ~= nil then
		local ok, err = Validate_Files(layout.files, id)

		if not ok then
			return false, err
		end
	end

	return true
end

Layouts.data = {

	defaults = {
		directories = {},

	},

local function Load_Source(path)
	if vim.fn.filereadable(path) ~= 1 then
		return nil
	end

	local data, err = Read_JSON(path)

	if not data then
		return nil, err
	end

	if type(data.layouts) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "JSON must contain a 'layouts' object: " .. path
	end

	return data
end

function Layouts.Load_File(path)
	local data, err = Load_Source(path)

	if not data then
		return nil, err
	end

	for id, layout in pairs(data.layouts) do
		local ok, validation_error = Validate_Layout(id, layout)

		if not ok then
			return nil, validation_error
		end
	end

	return data
end

function Layouts.Reload()
	local base = {
		version = 1,
		defaults = {
			directories = {},
			files = {},
		},
		credits = {
			path = "CREDITS.md",
			content = "",
		},
		languages = {},
		layouts = {},
	}

	local developer_data, developer_error = Layouts.Load_File(Layouts.json_path)

	if developer_data then
		base.version = developer_data.version or 1
		base.defaults = Merge(base.defaults, developer_data.defaults)
		base.credits = Merge(base.credits, developer_data.credits)
		base.languages = Merge(base.languages, developer_data.languages)
		base.layouts = Merge(base.layouts, developer_data.layouts)
	elseif vim.fn.filereadable(Layouts.json_path) == 1 then
		return false, developer_error
	end

	-- User-defined layouts override developer layouts.
	local user_data, user_error = Layouts.Load_File(Layouts.user_path)

	if user_data then
		base.layouts = Merge(base.layouts, user_data.layouts)
	elseif vim.fn.filereadable(Layouts.user_path) == 1 then
		return false, user_error
	end

	for id, layout in pairs(base.layouts) do
		local ok, err = Validate_Layout(id, layout)

		if not ok then
			return false, err
		end
	end

	if type(base.defaults.directories) ~= "table" or type(base.defaults.files) ~= "table" then
		return false, "defaults must contain directories and files"
	end

	local ok, err = Validate_Directories(base.defaults.directories, "defaults")

	if not ok then
		return false, err
	end

	ok, err = Validate_Files(base.defaults.files, "defaults")

	if not ok then
		return false, err
	end

	if type(base.languages) ~= "table" then
		return false, "languages must be an object"
	end

	if
		type(base.credits) ~= "table"
		or type(base.credits.path) ~= "string"
		or type(base.credits.content) ~= "string"
		or not Layouts.Is_Safe_Path(base.credits.path)
	then
		return false, "Invalid credits configuration"
	end

	Layouts.data = base
	return true
end

-- =========================================================

local function Replace_Placeholders(content, values)
	for key, value in pairs(values or {}) do
		content = content:gsub("{{" .. key .. "}}", function()
			return tostring(value)
		end)
	end

	return content
end

function Layouts.Get_Commands(language_id, project_name)
	local language = Layouts.Get_Language(language_id)

	local values = {
		PROJECT_NAME = project_name or "MyProject",
		LANGUAGE = language_id,
		BUILD_COMMAND = language.build or "Not configured",
		RUN_COMMAND = language.run or "Not configured",
		TEST_COMMAND = language.test or "Not configured",
		CLEAN_COMMAND = language.clean or "Not configured",
	}

	for key, value in pairs(language) do
		if type(value) == "string" then
			values[key:upper()] = value
		end
	end

	return values
end

-- =========================================================
-- BUILD A PROJECT FILE MANIFEST
-- =========================================================

function Layouts.Build_Manifest(language_id, layout_id, project_name)
	local defaults = Layouts.data.defaults
	local language = Layouts.Get_Language(language_id)
	local layout = layout_id and layout_id ~= "" and Layouts.Get(layout_id) or nil

	if layout_id and layout_id ~= "" and not layout then
		return nil, "Unknown layout: " .. tostring(layout_id)
	end

	if layout and layout.languages then
		local supported = false

		for _, allowed_id in ipairs(layout.languages) do
			if allowed_id == language_id then
				supported = true
				break
			end
		end

		if not supported then
			return nil, "Layout '" .. layout_id .. "' does not support language '" .. language_id .. "'"
		end
	end

	local directories = {}
	local directory_set = {}
	local files = {}

	local function Add_Directory(path)
		if not Layouts.Is_Safe_Path(path) then
			error("Unsafe directory path: " .. tostring(path))
		end

		if not directory_set[path] then
			directory_set[path] = true
			directories[#directories + 1] = path
		end
	end

	local function Add_Directories(list)
		for _, path in ipairs(list or {}) do
			Add_Directory(path)
		end
	end

	local function Add_Files(source)
		for path, content in pairs(source or {}) do
			if not Layouts.Is_Safe_Path(path) then
				error("Unsafe file path: " .. tostring(path))
			end

			if type(content) ~= "string" then
				error("Invalid file content: " .. tostring(path))
			end

			files[path] = content
		end
	end

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		-- 1. Common project structure.
		Add_Directories(defaults.directories)
		Add_Files(defaults.files)

		-- 2. Language-specific settings and optional files.
		Add_Directories(language.directories)
		Add_Files(language.files)

		-- 3. Universal credits file.
		files[Layouts.data.credits.path] = Layouts.data.credits.content

		-- 4. Selected specialized layout overrides defaults.
		if layout then
			Add_Directories(layout.directories)
			Add_Files(layout.files)
		end

		-- 5. Build a Makefile when language commands are configured.
		-- An explicit Makefile supplied by the layout takes precedence.
		if not files["Makefile"] and (language.build or language.run or language.test or language.clean) then
			local commands = Layouts.Get_Commands(language_id, project_name)

			local makefile = {
				".PHONY: all build run test clean",
				"",
			}

			if language.build then
				makefile[#makefile + 1] = "all: build"
				makefile[#makefile + 1] = ""
				makefile[#makefile + 1] = "build:"
				makefile[#makefile + 1] = "\t" .. language.build
				makefile[#makefile + 1] = ""
			else
				makefile[#makefile + 1] = "all:"
				makefile[#makefile + 1] = '\t@echo "No build command configured"'
				makefile[#makefile + 1] = ""
			end

			for _, target in ipairs({ "run", "test", "clean" }) do
				if language[target] then
					makefile[#makefile + 1] = target .. ":"
					makefile[#makefile + 1] = "\t" .. language[target]
					makefile[#makefile + 1] = ""
				end
			end

			files["Makefile"] = table.concat(makefile, "\n") .. "\n"
		end

		-- 6. Substitute documentation placeholders.
		local replacements = Layouts.Get_Commands(language_id, project_name)

		for path, content in pairs(files) do
			files[path] = Replace_Placeholders(content, replacements)
		end
	end)

	if not ok then
		return nil, tostring(err)
	end

	table.sort(directories)

	return {
		language = language_id,
		project_name = project_name or "MyProject",
		entry = layout and layout.entry or language.entry,
		directories = directories,
		files = files,
		commands = Layouts.Get_Commands(language_id, project_name),
		layout_id = layout_id,
	}
end

-- =========================================================
-- APPLY A PROJECT MANIFEST
-- =========================================================

local function Write_New_File(path, content)
	local parent = vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":h")

	local mkdir_ok = vim.fn.mkdir(parent, "p")

	if mkdir_ok == 0 and not Is_Directory(parent) then
		return false, "Could not create directory: " .. parent
	end

	-- Never overwrite an existing file.
	if uv.fs_lstat(path) then
		return false, "Refusing to overwrite existing path: " .. path
	end

	local file, err = io.open(path, "wx")

	if not file then
		-- Some Lua builds do not support exclusive creation mode.
		if err and err:find("invalid mode") then
			if uv.fs_lstat(path) then
				return false, "Refusing to overwrite existing path: " .. path
			end

			file, err = io.open(path, "w")
		end
	end

	if not file then
		return false, err
	end

	local write_ok, write_err = file:write(content)
	local close_ok, close_err = file:close()

	if not write_ok then
		return false, write_err
	end

	if close_ok == nil then
		return false, close_err
	end

	return true
end

function Layouts.Apply(root, layout, language_id, project_name)
	if type(root) ~= "string" or root == "" then
		return false, "Project root is required"
	end

	root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(root, ":p")

	if not Is_Directory(root) then
		return false, "Project root must already exist: " .. root
	end

	-- Backwards compatibility with Project.Create(root, layout).
	if type(layout) == "string" and language_id == nil then
		language_id = layout
		layout = nil
	end

	if type(layout) == "table" and layout.id then
		language_id = language_id or layout.language
	end

	local layout_id = nil

	if type(layout) == "string" then
		layout_id = layout
	elseif type(layout) == "table" then
		for id, registered in pairs(Layouts.data.layouts) do
			if registered == layout then
				layout_id = id
				break
			end
		end
	end

	language_id = language_id or "cpp"
	project_name = project_name or vim.fn.fnamemodify(root, ":t")

	local manifest, manifest_error = Layouts.Build_Manifest(language_id, layout_id, project_name)

	if not manifest then
		return false, manifest_error
	end

	-- Create directories first.
	for _, relative_path in ipairs(manifest.directories) do
		if not Layouts.Is_Safe_Path(relative_path) then
			return false, "Unsafe directory path: " .. relative_path
		end

		local full_path = root .. "/" .. relative_path
		local mkdir_ok = vim.fn.mkdir(full_path, "p")

		if mkdir_ok == 0 and not Is_Directory(full_path) then
			return false, "Could not create directory: " .. full_path
		end
	end

	-- Write files. Existing files are deliberately preserved.
	local paths = {}

	for path in pairs(manifest.files) do
		paths[#paths + 1] = path
	end

	table.sort(paths)

	for _, relative_path in ipairs(paths) do
		if not Layouts.Is_Safe_Path(relative_path) then
			return false, "Unsafe file path: " .. relative_path
		end

		local full_path = root .. "/" .. relative_path
		local ok, err = Write_New_File(full_path, manifest.files[relative_path])

		if not ok then
			return false, err
		end
	end

	return true, manifest
end

-- =========================================================
-- SAVE AND DELETE USER LAYOUTS
-- =========================================================

local function Read_User_Layouts()
	if vim.fn.filereadable(Layouts.user_path) ~= 1 then
		return {}
	end

	local data, err = Read_JSON(Layouts.user_path)

	if not data then
		return nil, err
	end

	if type(data.layouts) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "User layout file must contain a layouts object"
	end

	return data.layouts
end

function Layouts.Save(id, layout)
	if type(id) ~= "string" or not id:match("^[%w_-]+$") then
		return false, "Invalid layout ID"
	end

	local ok, err = Validate_Layout(id, layout)

	if not ok then
		return false, err
	end

	local user_layouts, read_error = Read_User_Layouts()

	if not user_layouts then
		return false, read_error
	end

	user_layouts[id] = Deep_Copy(layout)

	local saved, save_error = Write_JSON(Layouts.user_path, {
		version = 1,
		layouts = user_layouts,
	})

	if not saved then
		return false, save_error
	end

	local reloaded, reload_error = Layouts.Reload()

	if not reloaded then
		return false, reload_error
	end

	return true
end

function Layouts.Delete(id)
	if type(id) ~= "string" or not id:match("^[%w_-]+$") then
		return false, "Invalid layout ID"
	end

	local user_layouts, read_error = Read_User_Layouts()

	if not user_layouts then
		return false, read_error
	end

	if user_layouts[id] == nil then
		return false, "No user-saved layout exists with ID: " .. id
	end

	user_layouts[id] = nil

	local saved, save_error = Write_JSON(Layouts.user_path, {
		version = 1,
		layouts = user_layouts,
	})

	if not saved then
		return false, save_error
	end

	return Layouts.Reload()
end

local Progress = {}

local State = {
	buffer = nil,
	window = nil,
	title = "HyperMax",
	total = 0,
	completed = 0,
	message = "Preparing...",
	output = {},
	output_limit = 8,
}

local function Is_Valid_Window()
	return State.window and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(State.window)
end

local function Render()
	if not State.buffer or not vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(State.buffer) then
		return
	end

	local width = 32
	local percent = State.total > 0 and math.floor(State.completed / State.total * 100) or 0

	percent = math.max(0, math.min(100, percent))

	local filled = math.floor(width * percent / 100)
	local bar = string.rep("█", filled) .. string.rep("░", width - filled)

	local lines = {
		" " .. State.title,
		"",
		"[" .. bar .. "]",
		string.format("%d%%  (%d/%d)", percent, State.completed, State.total),
		"",
		"Current task:",
		State.message,
		"",
		"Output:",
	}

	local start = math.max(1, #State.output - State.output_limit + 1)

	for i = start, #State.output do
		lines[#lines + 1] = State.output[i]
	end

	vim.bo[State.buffer].modifiable = true
	vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(State.buffer, 0, -1, false, lines)
	vim.bo[State.buffer].modifiable = false

	if Is_Valid_Window() then
		vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor(State.window, { #lines, 0 })
	end
end

function Progress.Start(title, total)
	Progress.Close()

	State.title = title or "HyperMax"
	State.total = math.max(0, total or 0)
	State.completed = 0
	State.message = "Preparing..."
	State.output = {}

	State.buffer = vim.api.nvim_create_buf(false, true)

	vim.bo[State.buffer].buftype = "nofile"
	vim.bo[State.buffer].bufhidden = "wipe"
	vim.bo[State.buffer].swapfile = false
	vim.bo[State.buffer].modifiable = false
	vim.bo[State.buffer].filetype = "hypermax-progress"

	local width = math.min(68, vim.o.columns - 4)
	local height = math.min(18, vim.o.lines - 4)

	State.window = vim.api.nvim_open_win(State.buffer, true, {
		relative = "editor",
		width = width,
		height = height,
		row = math.max(0, math.floor((vim.o.lines - height) / 2) - 1),
		col = math.max(0, math.floor((vim.o.columns - width) / 2)),
		style = "minimal",
		border = "rounded",
		title = " HyperMax Progress ",
		title_pos = "center",
	})

	vim.wo[State.window].wrap = true
	Render()
end

function Progress.Update(message, completed, total)
	if total ~= nil then
		State.total = math.max(0, total)
	end

	if completed ~= nil then
		State.completed = math.max(0, completed)
	end

	State.message = message or State.message
	Render()
end

function Progress.Log(message)
	State.output[#State.output + 1] = tostring(message)
	Render()
end

function Progress.Increment(message)
	Progress.Update(message, math.min(State.completed + 1, State.total))
end

function Progress.Finish(success, message)
	State.message = message or (success and "Completed." or "Failed.")
	State.completed = success and State.total or State.completed

	Progress.Log(success and "Finished successfully." or "Operation failed.")
	Render()
end

function Progress.Close()
	if Is_Valid_Window() then
		vim.api.nvim_win_close(State.window, true)
	end

	if State.buffer and vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(State.buffer) then
		vim.api.nvim_buf_delete(State.buffer, { force = true })
	end

	State.window = nil
	State.buffer = nil
end

return Progress

-- =========================================================

local function Join_Path(...)
	local parts = { ... }
	return table.concat(parts, "/"):gsub("/+", "/")
end

local function Is_Safe_Relative_Path(path)
	if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" then
		return false
	end

	if path:find("%z") or path:find("\\") then
		return false
	end

	if path:sub(1, 1) == "/" then
		return false
	end

	if path:match("^%a:") then
		return false
	end

	for part in path:gmatch("[^/]+") do
		if part == "." or part == ".." then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

local function Is_Directory(path)
	local stat = uv.fs_stat(path)
	return stat ~= nil and stat.type == "directory"
end

local function Is_File(path)
	local stat = uv.fs_stat(path)
	return stat ~= nil and stat.type == "file"
end

local function Ensure_Directory(path)
	if Is_Directory(path) then
		return true
	end

	local ok = vim.fn.mkdir(path, "p")

	if ok == 0 and not Is_Directory(path) then
		return false, "Could not create directory: " .. path
	end

	return true
end

local function Read_File(path)
	local file = io.open(path, "rb")

	if not file then
		return nil
	end

	local contents = file:read("*a")
	file:close()

	return contents
end

-- Creates a file only if it does not already exist.
-- Uses exclusive creation so existing files are not overwritten.
local function Write_New_File(path, contents)
	local parent = vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":h")

	local ok, err = Ensure_Directory(parent)

	if not ok then
		return false, err
	end

	local fd, open_err = uv.fs_open(path, "wx", 420)

	if not fd then
		return false, open_err or ("Could not create " .. path)
	end

	local write_ok, write_err = true, nil

	if contents ~= "" then
		local written, result = uv.fs_write(fd, contents, 0)

		if not written then
			write_ok = false
			write_err = result or "File write failed."
		elseif written ~= #contents then
			write_ok = false
			write_err = "Incomplete file write."
		end
	end

	uv.fs_close(fd)

	if not write_ok then
		os.remove(path)
		return false, write_err
	end

	return true
end

local function Sort_Languages(ids, favourites)
	local rank = {}

	for index, id in ipairs(favourites or {}) do
		rank[id] = index
	end

	table.sort(ids, function(a, b)
		local a_rank = rank[a] or math.huge
		local b_rank = rank[b] or math.huge

		if a_rank ~= b_rank then
			return a_rank < b_rank
		end

		return a < b
	end)

	return ids
end

local function Build_Default_Manifest(language_id, manager_id, project_name, options)
	local manifest = {
		directories = {},
		files = {},
		entry = Get_Language_File(language_id),
	}

	-- Use the central layout system for shared defaults,
	-- language commands, credits, and selected layouts.
	local built = Layouts.Build_Manifest(language_id, "", project_name)

	if type(built) == "table" then
		manifest = built
		manifest.directories = manifest.directories or {}
		manifest.files = manifest.files or {}
	end

	-- Keep all paths relative to the new project root.
	local entry = manifest.entry or Get_Language_File(language_id)

	if not manifest.files[entry] then
		manifest.files[entry] = Get_Source_Template(language_id)
	end

	if options.create_readme and not manifest.files["README.md"] then
		manifest.files["README.md"] = Build_Readme(project_name, language_id, manager_id)
	end

	if options.create_gitignore and not manifest.files[".gitignore"] then
		manifest.files[".gitignore"] = [[build/
dist/
out/
*.o
*.obj
*.exe
*.class
__pycache__/
.venv/
venv/
node_modules/
target/
]]
	end

	if options.create_default_directories then
		local defaults = { "src", "tests", "docs" }

		for _, directory in ipairs(defaults) do
			if not vim.tbl_contains(manifest.directories, directory) then
				manifest.directories[#manifest.directories + 1] = directory
			end
		end
	end

	local manager_files = Get_Manager_Files(language_id, manager_id)

	for path, content in pairs(manager_files) do
		if not manifest.files[path] then
			manifest.files[path] = content
		end
	end

	return manifest
end

local function Build_Layout_Manifest(language_id, layout_id, project_name, manager_id, options)
	if not layout_id or layout_id == "" then
		return Build_Default_Manifest(language_id, manager_id, project_name, options)
	end

	local manifest = Layouts.Build_Manifest(language_id, layout_id, project_name)

	if type(manifest) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "Could not build layout manifest."
	end

	manifest.directories = manifest.directories or {}
	manifest.files = manifest.files or {}

	-- The layout may already contain its own manager files.
	-- Add missing files for the selected manager without replacing them.
	local manager_files = Get_Manager_Files(language_id, manager_id)

	for path, content in pairs(manager_files) do
		if not manifest.files[path] then
			manifest.files[path] = content
		end
	end

	if options.create_readme and not manifest.files["README.md"] then
		manifest.files["README.md"] = Build_Readme(project_name, language_id, manager_id)
	end

	if options.create_gitignore and not manifest.files[".gitignore"] then
		manifest.files[".gitignore"] = [[build/
dist/
out/
*.o
*.obj
*.exe
*.class
__pycache__/
.venv/
venv/
node_modules/
target/
]]
	end

	return manifest
end

-- =========================================================
-- PROGRESS AND MANIFEST WRITING
-- =========================================================

local function Add_Manifest_Task(tasks, root, relative_path, kind, content)
	if not Is_Safe_Relative_Path(relative_path) then
		return false, "Unsafe project path: " .. tostring(relative_path)
	end

	tasks[#tasks + 1] = {
		type = kind,
		relative_path = relative_path,
		full_path = Join_Path(root, relative_path),
		content = content,
	}

	return true
end

local function Create_From_Manifest(root, manifest, options)
	local tasks = {}
	local directories = {}
	local directory_seen = {}

	local function Add_Directory(relative_path)
		if not Is_Safe_Relative_Path(relative_path) then
			return false, "Unsafe directory path: " .. tostring(relative_path)
		end

		if not directory_seen[relative_path] then
			directory_seen[relative_path] = true
			directories[#directories + 1] = relative_path
		end

		return true
	end

	for _, directory in ipairs(manifest.directories or {}) do
		local ok, err = Add_Directory(directory)

		if not ok then
			return false, err
		end
	end

	for relative_path in pairs(manifest.files or {}) do
		if not Is_Safe_Relative_Path(relative_path) then
			return false, "Unsafe file path: " .. tostring(relative_path)
		end

		local parent = vim.fn.fnamemodify(relative_path, ":h")

		if parent ~= "." then
			local current = ""

			for part in parent:gmatch("[^/]+") do
				current = current == "" and part or (current .. "/" .. part)

				local ok, err = Add_Directory(current)

				if not ok then
					return false, err
				end
			end
		end
	end

	table.sort(directories, function(a, b)
		local a_depth = select(2, a:gsub("/", ""))
		local b_depth = select(2, b:gsub("/", ""))

		if a_depth ~= b_depth then
			return a_depth < b_depth
		end

		return a < b
	end)

	-- Directories are counted as work too.
	for _, directory in ipairs(directories) do
		tasks[#tasks + 1] = {
			type = "directory",
			relative_path = directory,
			full_path = Join_Path(root, directory),
		}
	end

	local file_paths = {}

	for relative_path in pairs(manifest.files or {}) do
		file_paths[#file_paths + 1] = relative_path
	end

	table.sort(file_paths)

	for _, relative_path in ipairs(file_paths) do
		local ok, err = Add_Manifest_Task(tasks, root, relative_path, "file", manifest.files[relative_path])

		if not ok then
			return false, err
		end
	end

	local total = #tasks
	local completed = 0

	if options.show_progress then
		Progress.Start("Creating project", total)
		Progress.Log("Project: " .. root)
	end

	local function Update_Progress(task)
		completed = completed + 1

		if options.show_progress then
			Progress.Update(task.type .. ": " .. task.relative_path, completed, total)
		end
	end

	-- Preflight before writing: do not overwrite existing files.
	for _, task in ipairs(tasks) do
		if task.type == "file" and uv.fs_stat(task.full_path) then
			if options.show_progress then
				Progress.Finish(false, "File already exists.")
				Progress.Log(task.full_path)
			end

			return false, "Refusing to overwrite existing file: " .. task.full_path
		end
	end

	local ok, err = Ensure_Directory(root)

	if not ok then
		if options.show_progress then
			Progress.Finish(false, err)
		end

		return false, err
	end

	for _, task in ipairs(tasks) do
		local task_ok, task_err

		if task.type == "directory" then
			task_ok, task_err = Ensure_Directory(task.full_path)
		else
			task_ok, task_err = Write_New_File(task.full_path, task.content or "")
		end

		if not task_ok then
			if options.show_progress then
				Progress.Log("ERROR: " .. task.relative_path)
				Progress.Log(tostring(task_err))
				Progress.Finish(false, "Project creation failed.")
			end

			return false, task_err
		end

		Update_Progress(task)
	end

	if options.show_progress then
		Progress.Finish(true, "Project created successfully.")
	end

	return true
end

local function Open_Project(root, entry, options)
	if not options.open_after_create then
		return
	end

	local relative_entry = entry or ""

	if relative_entry ~= "" and Is_Safe_Relative_Path(relative_entry) then
		local path = Join_Path(root, relative_entry)

		if Is_File(path) then
			vim.cmd("edit " .. vim.fn.fnameescape(path))

		end
	end

local function Create_Project(options, language_id, manager_id, root, project_name, layout_id)
	local language = Languages.Get(language_id)

	if options.remember_last_project ~= false then
		Config.options.last_project_path = root
		Config.save()
	end

	if not language then
		Notify("Unknown language: " .. language_id, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return
	end

	local manager = Managers.Get(language_id, manager_id)

	if not manager then
		Notify("Unknown manager '" .. manager_id .. "' for " .. language_id, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return
	end

	local manifest, manifest_err = Build_Layout_Manifest(language_id, layout_id, project_name, manager_id, options)

	if not manifest then
		Notify("Could not prepare project: " .. tostring(manifest_err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return
	end

	local entry = manifest.entry or Get_Language_File(language_id)

	local ok, err = Create_From_Manifest(root, manifest, options)

	if not ok then
		Notify("Project creation failed: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return
	end

	-- Initialize HyperMax project metadata after the files exist.
	local hmc_ok, hmc_result = Project_Config.Create(root, {
		name = project_name,
		language = language_id,
		manager = manager_id,
		creator = os.getenv("USER") or "unknown",
		entry_file = entry,
		entry_function = "main",
	})

	if not hmc_ok then
		Notify("Project created, but .hmc initialization failed: " .. tostring(hmc_result), vim.log.levels.WARN)
	else
		Notify("Created project and .hmc configuration: " .. root)
	end

	Open_Project(root, entry, options)
end

		if not manager then
			Notify("The native manager is not available for " .. language_id, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
			return
		end

		local root = Join_Path(location, project_name)

		if uv.fs_stat(root) then
			Notify("Project path already exists: " .. root, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
			return
		end

		-- Use the normal project generator with no custom layout.
		-- This preserves templates, progress, README, and gitignore
		-- settings configured in HyperMax.
		Check_Manager(language_id, manager_id, function(continue)
			if not continue then
				Notify("Quick project creation cancelled.")
				return
			end

			Create_Project(options, language_id, manager_id, root, project_name, "")
		end)
	end)
end

function Project.Create(user_options)
	local options = vim.tbl_deep_extend("force", {}, Config.options or {}, user_options or {})

	local language_ids = Get_Language_Choices(options)

	Select_Item(language_ids, "Choose project language", function(id)
		local favourite = vim.tbl_contains(options.favourite_languages or {}, id)

		return (favourite and "★ " or "  ") .. Get_Language_Name(id) .. " (" .. id .. ")"
	end, function(language_id)
		if not language_id then
			return
		end

		local manager_ids = Managers.Get_IDs(language_id)

		if type(manager_ids) ~= "table" or #manager_ids == 0 then
			manager_ids = { "native" }
		end

		local default_manager = options.default_manager or "native"

		-- Put the configured default manager first.
		table.sort(manager_ids, function(a, b)
			if a == default_manager then
				return true
			end

			if b == default_manager then
				return false
			end

			return a < b
		end)

		Select_Item(manager_ids, "Choose project manager", function(id)
			return Get_Manager_Name(language_id, id) .. " (" .. id .. ")"
		end, function(manager_id)
			if not manager_id then
				return
			end

			local default_location = options.project_dir or vim.fn.expand("~/Projects")

			Input("Project starting location: ", default_location, function(location)
				if location == nil then
					return
				end

				location = vim.trim(location)

				if location == "" then
					Notify("Project location cannot be empty.", vim.log.levels.ERROR)
					return
				end

				location = vim.fn.expand(location)

				Input("Project name: ", "MyProject", function(project_name)
					if project_name == nil then
						return
					end

					project_name = vim.trim(project_name)

					if
						project_name == ""
						or project_name:find("[/\\]")
						or project_name == "."
						or project_name == ".."
					then
						Notify("Invalid project name.", vim.log.levels.ERROR)
						return
					end

					local layouts = Layouts.Get_For_Language(language_id) or {}

					local choices = {
						{
							id = "",
							name = "Default project",
							description = "Use the standard project structure.",
						},
					}

					for _, layout in ipairs(layouts) do
						if type(layout) == "string" then
							local item = Layouts.Get(layout)

							if item then
								choices[#choices + 1] = item
							end
						elseif type(layout) == "table" then
							choices[#choices + 1] = layout
						end
					end

					local preferred_layout = options.default_layout or ""

					table.sort(choices, function(a, b)
						if a.id == preferred_layout then
							return true
						end

						if b.id == preferred_layout then
							return false
						end

						return (a.name or a.id) < (b.name or b.id)
					end)

					Select_Item(choices, "Choose project layout", function(layout)
						local name = layout.name or layout.id or "Default project"

						local description = layout.description

						if description and description ~= "" then
							return name .. " — " .. description
						end

						return name
					end, function(layout)
						if not layout then
							return
						end

						local layout_id = layout.id or ""

						local root = Join_Path(location, project_name)

						if uv.fs_stat(root) then
							Notify("Project path already exists: " .. root, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
							return
						end

						local function Continue()
							Check_Manager(language_id, manager_id, function(continue)
								if not continue then
									Notify("Project creation cancelled.")
									return
								end

								Create_Project(options, language_id, manager_id, root, project_name, layout_id)
							end)
						end

						if options.confirm_before_create then
							Confirm("Create " .. project_name .. " in " .. root .. "?", function(confirmed)
								if confirmed then
									Continue()
								else
									Notify("Project creation cancelled.")
								end
							end)
						else
							Continue()
						end
					end)
				end)
			end)
		end)
	end)
end

			local path = Join_Path(root, name)

			projects[#projects + 1] = {

				path = path,

		return a.name:lower() < b.name:lower()
	end)

		return project.name

-- =========================================================

local function Scan_Directory(root)
	local layout = {
		name = vim.fn.fnamemodify(root, ":t"),
		description = "",
		directories = {},
		files = {},
	}

	local ignored = {
		[".git"] = true,
		[".hg"] = true,
		[".svn"] = true,
		["node_modules"] = true,
		["target"] = true,
		["build"] = true,
		["dist"] = true,
		[".venv"] = true,
		["venv"] = true,
		["__pycache__"] = true,
		[".idea"] = true,
		[".vscode"] = true,
	}

	local function Walk(directory, relative)
		local entries = uv.fs_scandir(directory)

		if not entries then
			return
		end

		while true do
			local name, kind = uv.fs_scandir_next(entries)

			if not name then
				break
			end

			if not ignored[name] and name:sub(1, 1) ~= "." then
				local relative_path = relative == "" and name or (relative .. "/" .. name)

				local full_path = Join_Path(directory, name)

				if kind == "directory" then
					if Is_Safe_Relative_Path(relative_path) then
						layout.directories[#layout.directories + 1] = relative_path

						Walk(full_path, relative_path)
					end
				elseif kind == "file" and Is_Safe_Relative_Path(relative_path) then
					local contents = Read_File(full_path)

					if contents ~= nil then
						layout.files[relative_path] = contents
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	Walk(root, "")

	return layout
end

function Project.Save_Layout()
	local current = vim.fn.getcwd()

	Input("Layout ID (letters, numbers, '_' or '-'): ", vim.fn.fnamemodify(current, ":t"), function(id)
		id = vim.trim(id or "")

		if not id:match("^[%w_-]+$") then
			Notify("Invalid layout ID.", vim.log.levels.ERROR)
			return
		end

		local layout = Scan_Directory(current)

		Input("Layout display name: ", layout.name, function(name)
			name = vim.trim(name or "")

			if name == "" then
				Notify("Layout name cannot be empty.", vim.log.levels.ERROR)
				return
			end

			layout.name = name

			Input("Description: ", layout.description, function(description)
				layout.description = description or ""

				Confirm("Save layout '" .. id .. "' to HyperMax?", function(save)
					if not save then
						Notify("Layout save cancelled.")
						return
					end

					local ok, err = Layouts.Save(id, layout)

					if not ok then
						Notify("Could not save layout: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
						return
					end

					Notify("Saved layout '" .. id .. "' from " .. current)
				end)
			end)
		end)
	end)
end

local Project_Config = {}

local uv = vim.uv or vim.loop

local DATA_VERSION = 1
local HISTORY_HEADER = "HMXHIST\0" .. string.char(0, 0, 0, DATA_VERSION)

local IGNORED_DIRECTORIES = {
	[".git"] = true,
	[".hmc"] = true,
	["node_modules"] = true,
	["vendor"] = true,
	["target"] = true,
	["build"] = true,
	[".venv"] = true,
	["venv"] = true,
}

local MAX_LAYOUT_FILE_SIZE = 1024 * 1024

-- =========================================================
-- PATHS
-- =========================================================

local function Join(...)
	return table.concat({ ... }, "/"):gsub("/+", "/")
end

local function Get_Global_Directory()
	return Join(vim.fn.stdpath("data"), "hypermax")
end

local function Get_Global_Config_Path()
	return Join(Get_Global_Directory(), "config.json")
end

local function Get_HMC_Directory(project_root)
	return Join(project_root, ".hmc")
end

local function Get_HMC_Paths(project_root)
	local directory = Get_HMC_Directory(project_root)

	return {
		directory = directory,
		layout = Join(directory, "layout.json"),
		config = Join(directory, "config.json"),
		basics = Join(directory, "basics.json"),
		history = Join(directory, "project.bin"),
	}
end

-- =========================================================
-- FILESYSTEM
-- =========================================================

local function Ensure_Directory(path)
	if vim.fn.isdirectory(path) == 1 then
		return true
	end

	local result = vim.fn.mkdir(path, "p")

	if result == 0 and vim.fn.isdirectory(path) ~= 1 then
		return false, "Could not create directory: " .. path
	end

	return true
end

local function Read_File(path)
	local file = io.open(path, "rb")

	if not file then
		return nil
	end

	local content = file:read("*a")
	file:close()

	return content
end

local function Write_File(path, content)
	local file, err = io.open(path, "wb")

	if not file then
		return false, err
	end

	local ok, write_err = file:write(content)

	if not ok then
		file:close()
		return false, write_err
	end

	local closed, close_err = file:close()

	if closed == nil then
		return false, close_err
	end

	return true
end

local function Read_JSON(path, fallback)
	local content = Read_File(path)

	if not content or content == "" then
		return vim.deepcopy(fallback)
	end

	local ok, data = pcall(vim.json.decode, content)

	if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "Invalid JSON: " .. path
	end

	return data
end

local function Write_JSON(path, data)
	local ok, encoded = pcall(vim.json.encode, data)

	if not ok then
		return false, encoded
	end

	return Write_File(path, encoded .. "\n")
end

-- =========================================================
-- DIRECTORY CAPTURE
-- =========================================================

local function Capture_Directory(project_root)
	local entries = {}
	local errors = {}

	local function Scan(directory, relative)
		local handle, err = uv.fs_scandir(directory)

		if not handle then
			errors[#errors + 1] = tostring(err)
			return
		end

		while true do
			local name, kind = uv.fs_scandir_next(handle)

			if not name then
				break
			end

			if not (kind == "directory" and IGNORED_DIRECTORIES[name]) then
				local relative_path = relative == "" and name or relative .. "/" .. name

				local full_path = Join(directory, name)

				if kind == "directory" then
					entries[#entries + 1] = {
						path = relative_path,
						type = "directory",
					}

					Scan(full_path, relative_path)
				elseif kind == "file" then
					local stat = uv.fs_stat(full_path)

					local entry = {
						path = relative_path,
						type = "file",
						content_saved = false,
					}

					if stat and stat.size <= MAX_LAYOUT_FILE_SIZE then
						local content = Read_File(full_path)

						-- Avoid saving likely binary files as text.
						if content and not content:find("\0", 1, true) then
							entry.content = content
							entry.content_saved = true
						end
					end

					entries[#entries + 1] = entry
				end
			end
		end
	end

	Scan(project_root, "")

	table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
		return a.path < b.path
	end)

	return {
		version = DATA_VERSION,
		entries = entries,
		capture_errors = errors,
		captured_at = os.time(),
	}
end

	if not ok then

	end

	if vim.fn.filereadable(path) == 0 then
		local saved, save_err = Write_JSON(path, Default_Global_Config())

		if not saved then
			return nil, save_err
		end
	end

	return Read_JSON(path, Default_Global_Config())
end

-- =========================================================

function Project_Config.Create(project_root, metadata)
	project_root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(project_root, ":p")
	metadata = vim.deepcopy(metadata or {})
	metadata.root = project_root

	local paths = Get_HMC_Paths(project_root)

	if vim.fn.isdirectory(project_root) ~= 1 then
		return false, "Project directory does not exist: " .. project_root
	end

	if Project_Config.Exists(project_root) then
		return false, "This project already has a .hmc directory"
	end

	local ok, err = Ensure_Directory(paths.directory)

	if not ok then
		return false, err
	end

	local files = {
		{
			path = paths.basics,
			data = Default_Basics(metadata),
		},
		{
			path = paths.config,
			data = Default_Project_Config(),
		},
		{
			path = paths.layout,
			data = Capture_Directory(project_root),
		},
	}

	for _, item in ipairs(files) do
		local saved, save_err = Write_JSON(item.path, item.data)

		if not saved then
			pcall(vim.fn.delete, paths.directory, "rf")
			return false, save_err
		end
	end

	local history_saved, history_err = Write_File(paths.history, HISTORY_HEADER)

	if not history_saved then
		pcall(vim.fn.delete, paths.directory, "rf")
		return false, history_err
	end

	return true, paths
end

local function Read_Legacy_Basics(paths)
	local candidates = {
		paths.basics,
		Join(paths.directory, "basic.json"),
		Join(paths.directory, "project.json"),
		Join(paths.directory, "metadata.json"),
		Join(paths.directory, "project_config.json"),
		Join(paths.directory, "hypermax.json"),
	}
	local empty_data
	for _, path in ipairs(candidates) do
		if vim.fn.filereadable(path) == 1 then
			local data, err = Read_JSON(path, {})
			if not data then return nil, err end
			if type(data.project) ~= "table" or next(data.project) == nil then
				local project_keys = { "name", "root", "language", "manager", "creator", "created_at", "entry_file", "entry_function", "entry_point", "project_name", "project_root" }
				local project = {}
				for _, key in ipairs(project_keys) do
					if data[key] ~= nil then project[key] = data[key] end
				end
				project.name = project.name or data.project_name
				project.root = project.root or data.project_root
				if next(project) then data.project = project end
			end
			if type(data.project) == "table" and next(data.project) then
				data.project.entry_point = data.project.entry_point or {
					file = data.project.entry_file or data.entry_file or "",
					["function"] = data.project.entry_function or data.entry_function or "main",
				}
				data.git = data.git or { enabled = vim.fn.isdirectory(vim.fn.fnamemodify(paths.directory, ":h") .. "/.git") == 1 }
				return data
			end
			empty_data = data
		end
	end
	return empty_data or {}, nil
end

local function Read_Legacy_Config(paths)
	if vim.fn.filereadable(paths.config) == 1 then
		return Read_JSON(paths.config, Default_Project_Config())
	end
	for _, path in ipairs({ Join(paths.directory, "settings.json"), Join(paths.directory, "options.json") }) do
		if vim.fn.filereadable(path) == 1 then
			local data, err = Read_JSON(path, Default_Project_Config())
			if not data then return nil, err end
			if type(data.settings) ~= "table" then data = { version = data.version or DATA_VERSION, settings = data } end
			return data
		end
	end
	return Default_Project_Config(), nil
end

local function Read_Legacy_Layout(paths)
	local candidates = { paths.layout, Join(paths.directory, "tree.json"), Join(paths.directory, "files.json"), Join(paths.directory, "project_layout.json") }
	for _, path in ipairs(candidates) do
		if vim.fn.filereadable(path) == 1 then
			local data, err = Read_JSON(path, { version = DATA_VERSION, entries = {} })
			if not data then return nil, err end
			if type(data.entries) ~= "table" and type(data.files) == "table" then data.entries = data.files end
			data.entries = data.entries or {}
			data.version = data.version or DATA_VERSION
			return data
		end
	end
	return { version = DATA_VERSION, entries = {} }, nil
end

function Project_Config.Load(project_root)
	project_root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(project_root, ":p")

	local paths = Get_HMC_Paths(project_root)

	if not Project_Config.Exists(project_root) then
		return nil, "No .hmc directory exists in this project"
	end

	local basics, basics_err = Read_Legacy_Basics(paths)
	local config, config_err = Read_Legacy_Config(paths)
	local layout, layout_err = Read_Legacy_Layout(paths)

	if not basics then
		return nil, basics_err
	end

	if not config then
		return nil, config_err
	end

	if not layout then
		return nil, layout_err
	end

	return {
		root = project_root,
		paths = paths,
		basics = basics,
		config = config,
		layout = layout,
	}
end

local function Remove_HMC(project_root, require_conversion)
	project_root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.expand(project_root or ""), ":p")
	local loaded, err = Project_Config.Load(project_root)
	if not loaded then return false, err end
	if require_conversion and not (loaded.basics.conversion and loaded.basics.conversion.kind == "folder_conversion") then
		return false, "This project was not created by folder conversion; refusing to undo it"
	end
	local directory = loaded.paths.directory
	local stat = uv.fs_lstat(directory)
	if not stat or stat.type ~= "directory" then return false, "The .hmc metadata path is not a real directory" end
	local backup = directory .. ".backup-" .. os.date("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
	local renamed, rename_err = uv.fs_rename(directory, backup)
	if not renamed then return false, "Could not safely back up .hmc: " .. tostring(rename_err) end
	return true, backup
end

function Project_Config.Undo_Conversion(project_root)
	return Remove_HMC(project_root, true)
end

function Project_Config.Scrape(project_root)
	return Remove_HMC(project_root, false)
end

function Project_Config.Save_Project_Settings(project_root, settings)
	local paths = Get_HMC_Paths(vim.fn.fnamemodify(project_root, ":p"))

	if not Project_Config.Exists(project_root) then
		return false, "This project has no .hmc directory"
	end

	local config, err = Read_JSON(paths.config, Default_Project_Config())

	if not config then
		return false, err
	end

	config.settings = config.settings or {}

	for key, value in pairs(settings) do
		config.settings[key] = value
	end

	return Write_JSON(paths.config, config)
end

function Project_Config.Save_Setting(project_root, key, value)
	vim.ui.select({
		"This project only",
		"Global HyperMax defaults",
		"Cancel",
	}, {
		prompt = "Where should this setting be saved?",
	}, function(choice)
		if choice == "This project only" then
			local ok, err = Project_Config.Save_Project_Settings(project_root, { [key] = value })

			if not ok then
				vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
				return
			end

			vim.notify("Saved to project configuration")
		elseif choice == "Global HyperMax defaults" then
			local global, err = Project_Config.Get_Global()

			if not global then
				vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
				return
			end

			global.settings = global.settings or {}
			global.settings[key] = value

			local ok, save_err = Project_Config.Save_Global(global)

			if not ok then
				vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. tostring(save_err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
				return
			end

			vim.notify("Saved to global HyperMax configuration")
		end
	end)
end

return Project_Config

local function Notify(message)

local function Save(key, value)

end

local function Edit_Text(key, label)
	vim.ui.input({
		prompt = label .. ": ",
		default = tostring(Config.get(key) or ""),
	}, function(value)
		if value == nil then
			return
		end

		Save(key, value)
	end)
end

local function Edit_Boolean(key, label)
	local current = Config.get(key)

	vim.ui.select({ "Yes", "No" }, {
		prompt = label,
		format_item = function(item)
			if (item == "Yes") == current then
				return item .. "  (current)"
			end

			return item
		end,
	}, function(choice)
		if choice == nil then
			return
		end

		Save(key, choice == "Yes")
	end)
end

local function Edit_Language()
	local ids = Languages.Get_IDs()
	local favourites = Config.get("favourite_languages") or {}

	table.sort(ids, function(a, b)
		local function Is_Favourite(id)
			return vim.tbl_contains(favourites, id)
		end

		if Is_Favourite(a) ~= Is_Favourite(b) then
			return Is_Favourite(a)
		end

		return a < b
	end)

	vim.ui.select(ids, {
		prompt = "Choose default language",
		format_item = function(id)
			if vim.tbl_contains(favourites, id) then
				return "★ " .. id
			end

			return id
		end,
	}, function(choice)
		if choice then
			Save("default_language", choice)
		end
	end)
end

local function Edit_Favourites()
	local current = table.concat(Config.get("favourite_languages") or {}, ", ")

	vim.ui.input({
		prompt = "Favourite languages (comma-separated): ",
		default = current,
	}, function(value)
		if value == nil then
			return
		end

		local favourites = {}
		local seen = {}

		for id in value:gmatch("[^,]+") do
			id = vim.trim(id)

			if Languages.Exists(id) and not seen[id] then
				favourites[#favourites + 1] = id
				seen[id] = true
			elseif id ~= "" and not Languages.Exists(id) then
				Notify("Unknown language ignored: " .. id)
			end
		end

		Save("favourite_languages", favourites)
	end)
end

local function Edit_Manager()
	local Managers = require("hypermax.managers")
	local language = Config.get("default_language")
	local managers = Managers.Get_IDs(language)

	if #managers == 0 then
		Notify("No managers registered for " .. language .. ".")
		return
	end

	vim.ui.select(managers, {
		prompt = "Default manager for " .. language,
	}, function(choice)
		if choice then
			Save("default_manager", choice)
		end
	end)
end

local function Edit_Setting(key, label)
	if Boolean_Settings[key] then
		Edit_Boolean(key, label)
	elseif key == "default_language" then
		Edit_Language()
	elseif key == "favourite_languages" then
		Edit_Favourites()
	elseif key == "default_manager" then
		Edit_Manager()
	elseif key == "project_dir" then
		Edit_Text(key, label)
	elseif key == "default_layout" then
		Edit_Text(key, label)
	end
end

function Settings.Open()
	local entries = {
		{ label = "Default language", key = "default_language" },
		{ label = "Project starting location", key = "project_dir" },
		{ label = "Favourite languages", key = "favourite_languages" },
		{ label = "Default manager", key = "default_manager" },
		{ label = "Default layout ID", key = "default_layout" },
	}

	for key, label in pairs(Boolean_Settings) do
		entries[#entries + 1] = {
			label = label,
			key = key,
		}
	end

	table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
		return a.label < b.label
	end)

	local choices = {}

	for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
		local value = Config.get(entry.key)

		if type(value) == "table" then
			value = table.concat(value, ", ")
		end

		choices[#choices + 1] = {
			entry = entry,
			text = entry.label .. " = " .. tostring(value),
		}
	end

	choices[#choices + 1] = {
		reset = true,
		text = "Reset all settings to defaults",
	}

	vim.ui.select(choices, {
		prompt = "HyperMax Settings",
		format_item = function(item)
			return item.text
		end,
	}, function(choice)
		if not choice then
			return
		end

		if choice.reset then
			vim.ui.select({ "Cancel", "Reset" }, {
				prompt = "Reset all HyperMax settings?",
			}, function(answer)
				if answer == "Reset" then
					Config.reset()
					Notify("Settings reset.")
					Settings.Open()
				end
			end)

			return
		end

		Edit_Setting(choice.entry.key, choice.entry.label)
	end)
end

return Settings

local function Flush_Scheduled_Callbacks()

Test("Dashboard: dashboard can reopen after its buffer is deleted", function()
	local Root = Create_Test_Directory()
	local ok, err = pcall(Dashboard.Open, Root)
	Assert(ok, "Dashboard open failed: " .. tostring(err))

	local state = Dashboard.Get_State()
	local old_buffer = state.buffer
	local old_window = state.window

	Assert(vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(old_buffer), "Dashboard buffer should initially be valid")
	Assert(vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(old_window), "Dashboard panel window should initially be valid")

	local editor_window
	for _, win in ipairs(vim.api.nvim_tabpage_list_wins(0)) do
		if win ~= old_window then
			editor_window = win
			break
		end
	end
	Assert(editor_window ~= nil, "Dashboard should leave an editor window beside the panel")
	vim.api.nvim_set_current_win(editor_window)
	-- Neovim will keep a buffer alive while a window still displays it.
	-- Replace the panel's buffer first, then verify the old one can be wiped.
	local replacement_buffer = vim.api.nvim_create_buf(false, true)
	vim.api.nvim_win_set_buf(old_window, replacement_buffer)
	vim.api.nvim_buf_delete(old_buffer, { force = true })

	Assert(not vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(old_buffer), "Old dashboard buffer should be deleted")

	local reopened, reopen_err = pcall(Dashboard.Open, Root)
	Assert(reopened, "Dashboard should reopen after deletion: " .. tostring(reopen_err))
	Assert(vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf()), "Current buffer should be valid after reopening")
	if vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(replacement_buffer) then
		pcall(vim.api.nvim_buf_delete, replacement_buffer, { force = true })
	end

	Remove_Test_Directory(Root)
end)

local function Is_Executable(executable)
	return executable ~= nil and executable ~= "" and vim.fn.executable(executable) == 1
end

local function Get_Version(executable)
	for _, flag in ipairs(Version_Flags) do
		local output = vim.fn.systemlist({ executable, flag })
		local exit_code = vim.v.shell_error

		if exit_code == 0 and output and #output > 0 then
			return true, table.concat(output, "\n"), flag
		end
	end

	return false, nil, nil
end

local function First_Line(text)
	if not text then
		return ""
	end

	return text:match("([^\n]*)") or ""
end
